## CH10_S01_SUNDERING_DASHBOARD
Where: Crimson Citadel orbit
Core: Queen reviews unity degradation matrices and approves creature deployment.
Hooks:
- “Exploit the Faultline”: pick which faction gets hit first (pressure map).
- “Hide the Signal”: attempt to mask cohesion signatures from Needle sensors (stealth diplomacy).

## CH10_S02_QUARRY_THE_GRUULITH
Where: Genesis Chambers
Core: Gruulith design: giant-derived resilience, soul removed.
Hooks:
- “Steal the Template”: acquire a flaw in their camouflage logic (countermeasure unlock).
- “Chain of Command”: plant a command-conflict in their hierarchy (future exploit).

## CH10_S03_AERIE_INVASION
Where: Singing Peaks (Ash territory)
Core: terrain becomes enemy; Gruulith emerge from mountain and exterminate.
Hooks:
- “Find the Spark”: discover they have no negotiable consciousness (tactical update).
- “The Help Call”: send kha SOS beyond isolation borders (Alliance_Request flag, political cost).

## CH10_S04_TO_BE_CONTINUED_GATE
Where: aftermath
Core: Phase 2 promise: escalation.
Hooks:
- “Alliance Terms Draft”: set what help costs and what is shared.
